title: Pausanias
summary: Raleigh names Pausanias in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Pausanias, the Greeke writer cited on Proserpina, Tereus, Tityus, the Labyrinth, and the translation of Argos. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIII, §. II, sig. 263a–263b
